title: moja.work portfolio
description: Read-only portfolio MCP: buzzword glossary (DE/EN), projects, career timeline, contact, docs.
summary: Read-only portfolio MCP: buzzword glossary (DE/EN), projects, career timeline, contact, docs.
offersHint: Read-only portfolio MCP: buzzword glossary (DE/EN), projects, career timeline, contact, docs. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://moja.work/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_buzzwords
toolsPreview.description: List all tech/tool buzzwords in the moja.work glossary as {id, label, category}. Optional category filter (e.g. framework, language, tooling, design, os).

toolsPreview.name: get_buzzword
toolsPreview.description: Get the full glossary entry (plain text) for one buzzword by its id.

toolsPreview.name: search_buzzwords
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across the buzzword glossary; returns matching entries with a snippet.

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: List the DIY / design projects showcased on moja.work as {id, headline, intro}. Includes each project intro so no per-project follow-up call is needed.

toolsPreview.name: get_project
toolsPreview.description: Get a project intro (plain text) plus its images by project id. Every image carries a full-size url and a thumb. imageMode is "gallery" for an ordinary series of photos, or "tiles" when the thumbnails are the pieces of one large picture — such a project returns the same full-size url for every tile on purpose.

toolsPreview.name: get_timeline
toolsPreview.description: Get the professional career timeline / CV of Markus Lungwitz: the introduction of the timeline page as plain text, plus the stations with descriptions and keywords.

toolsPreview.name: get_epos
toolsPreview.description: Get "The Chronicle of the Three Realms" — the epic retelling of the moja.work git history — as an ordered list of sections {anker, headline, url, text}. Optional `anker` returns a single section (e.g. intro, prologue, canto-01, epilogue).

toolsPreview.name: get_contact
toolsPreview.description: Get public contact details / vCard (name, email, phone, url, avatar, QR code).

toolsPreview.name: get_references
toolsPreview.description: Get external design references (Behance projects) as {id, name, url, fields, cover}.

toolsPreview.name: list_youtube_playlists
toolsPreview.description: List the public YouTube playlists of the moja.work channel as {id, title, description, thumbnail, itemCount, publishedAt}.

toolsPreview.name: get_youtube_playlist
toolsPreview.description: Get one YouTube playlist of the moja.work channel by id, including its videos with full descriptions {id, title, description, thumbnail, publishedAt, position}.

toolsPreview.name: list_docs
toolsPreview.description: List the auto-generated code documentation sets (Compodoc) for the moja-work monorepo, with their URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_docs
toolsPreview.description: Get the LLM-friendly code documentation (Compodoc llm-md export) for one project of the monorepo. Can be large.
